config.label: Execution mode: 'preview' simulates trades in a local SQLite DB (default, safe for inspection); 'live' places real orders on Polymarket and requires all POLY_* credentials
config.description: Execution mode: 'preview' simulates trades in a local SQLite DB (default, safe for inspection); 'live' places real orders on Polymarket and requires all POLY_* credentials.

config.label: Polygon wallet private key used to sign CLOB orders
config.description: Polygon wallet private key used to sign CLOB orders. Required only when COPY_MODE=live. Never logged, persisted, or transmitted outside signed order bodies.

config.label: Polymarket CLOB API key
config.description: Polymarket CLOB API key. Required only when COPY_MODE=live.

config.label: Polymarket CLOB API secret
config.description: Polymarket CLOB API secret. Required only when COPY_MODE=live.

config.label: Polymarket CLOB API passphrase
config.description: Polymarket CLOB API passphrase. Required only when COPY_MODE=live.

config.label: Polymarket funder wallet address (proxy wallet) used for live trading
config.description: Polymarket funder wallet address (proxy wallet) used for live trading.

config.label: Maximum USDC the agent may spend per day
config.description: Maximum USDC the agent may spend per day. Used by BudgetManager to cap copy-trading exposure.

config.label: Minimum conviction score (0–100) required before a copy trade is executed
config.description: Minimum conviction score (0–100) required before a copy trade is executed.

config.label: EVM chain ID for Polymarket (137 = Polygon mainnet)
config.description: EVM chain ID for Polymarket (137 = Polygon mainnet).

config.description: Optional override for the SQLite database path. Defaults to a package-local file.
